ONBOARDING.LOAD_ERROR_BODY: Check your connection and try again. What you wrote wasn't lost.
ONBOARDING.DONE_TITLE: Done! We now know your company
ONBOARDING.DONE_BODY: We saved the information for {{name}}. You can edit it again whenever you like from “My company”.
ONBOARDING.S1_BODY: With this we personalize everything that follows. It will take a couple of minutes.
ONBOARDING.LEGAL_NAME_HELP: Monkey registered it when creating your account, so it can't be changed here.
ONBOARDING.DESC_PLACEHOLDER: For example: We develop billing software for small businesses in Latin America.
ONBOARDING.DESC_ERROR: Briefly tell us what your company does.
ONBOARDING.DESC_HELP: In your own words, in one or two sentences.
ONBOARDING.S2_BODY: It helps us suggest a path that fits your size.
ONBOARDING.YEARS_LABEL: How many years has your company been operating?
ONBOARDING.S3_TITLE: Which sector do you work in?
ONBOARDING.S3_BODY: Choose the closest option; it doesn't have to be exact.
ONBOARDING.MODEL_LABEL: How do you describe your business model?
ONBOARDING.MODEL_HINT: Choose your business model to continue.
ONBOARDING.INCORP_LABEL: In which countries is your company incorporated?
ONBOARDING.CLIENT_LABEL: In which countries do you have clients?
ONBOARDING.S5_TITLE: How are you doing with compliance?
ONBOARDING.S5_BODY: No pressure: it helps us know where to start with you.
ONBOARDING.MATURITY_LABEL: How advanced is your company on compliance topics?
ONBOARDING.REGULATIONS_LABEL: Which data protection laws or standards apply to you?
ONBOARDING.REGULATIONS_HELP: Choose all that apply. If none, choose “None”.
ONBOARDING.REVIEW_TITLE_EDIT: This is what we know about your company
ONBOARDING.REVIEW_BODY: If everything looks right, save it. You can edit it later.
ONBOARDING.SAVE_ERROR: We couldn't save your information. Please try again.
